description: GBP SONIA curve built the way the platform's seeded 'GBP SONIA OIS (BoE, daily public)' curve is: a 6M deposit plus annual SwapHelpers (fixed leg Annual / ModifiedFollowing / Actual365Fixed on the UK calendar) whose float index is the SONIA overnight index, so the Bank of England public par strip reproduces. Curve Actual365Fixed / LogLinear / Discount.
provenance: index: index as defined by QuantLib 1.41 (the engine's QuantLib) QuantLib::Sonia in ql/indexes/ibor/sonia.hpp (https://github.com/lballabio/QuantLib/blob/v1.41/ql/indexes/ibor/sonia.hpp; constructor in ql/indexes/ibor/sonia.cpp, https://github.com/lballabio/QuantLib/blob/v1.41/ql/indexes/ibor/sonia.cpp: 0 fixing days, GBP, UnitedKingdom(UnitedKingdom::Exchange), Actual365Fixed; the engine's Calendar enum value UnitedKingdom); business_day_convention / end_of_month: the engine fixtures' values (QuantLib's OvernightIndex passes Following / false to IborIndex; a 1-day tenor advances by business days, so neither enters its fixing or value dates); deposit helper (fixing_days 0, UnitedKingdom, ModifiedFollowing, Actual365Fixed) and swap helper (Annual fixed leg, ModifiedFollowing, Actual365Fixed on UnitedKingdom, SONIA floating index): market standard (ISDA/CCP) for GBP SONIA-referencing swaps, not from an in-repo source; curve day counter / interpolator / trait: modelling choice (Actual365Fixed; LogLinear / Discount as the SOFR gold example)
